content.value_statement: Manual code reviews can miss quality, security, and test coverage issues. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured review prompts, scripts, and checklists.
actual_capabilities: Validates that a target path exists before running helper scripts.
Generates a basic console report with target, status, and finding count.
Can write the basic result report as JSON when an output path is provided.
Provides review guidance for quality, performance, security, and maintainability.
Links reference documents for checklists, standards, and anti-patterns.
limitations: The included scripts currently return a basic success report with empty findings.
The scripts do not parse git diffs, dependency metadata, or language ASTs.
It does not replace manual review by a domain owner.
Commands and output paths require user approval before execution.

use_cases.title: Review Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Check a proposed change for correctness, readability, security concerns, and missing tests before merge.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Reviews
use_cases.description: Use shared checklists and standards so reviewers give consistent feedback across projects.

use_cases.title: Prepare Release Reviews
use_cases.description: Summarize quality risks and follow-up work before a release candidate moves forward.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Review Pass
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner wants clear feedback on a small change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the code-reviewer skill to review this small change. Focus on correctness, readability, and simple test gaps. Return prioritized findings and suggested fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Pull Request Risk Check
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer needs a merge-ready review summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request with the skill checklists. Group findings by severity, explain impact, and note missing tests. End with a merge recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Security and Performance Review
prompt_templates.scenario: A team wants focused review on operational risk.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the code-reviewer references to inspect this change for security and performance issues. Call out risky inputs, slow paths, and weak error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Release Readiness Review
prompt_templates.scenario: A senior reviewer needs a broad final review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill with relevant scripts and references. Compare the change against coding standards, anti-patterns, and test coverage. Separate blockers from follow-up improvements.

output_examples.input: Review a small authentication change before merge.
output: High: missing tests for failed login handling.
Medium: error messages reveal too much account state.
Low: rename one helper for clearer intent.

output_examples.input: Summarize review readiness for a payment service update.
output_examples.output: The change is close to ready. Resolve the validation gap, add retry tests, and document the rollback plan before merge.

output_examples.input: Check whether a refactor follows team standards.
output: The module boundaries are clearer after the refactor.
Two renamed functions need migration notes.
Add one integration test for the changed data flow.

best_practices: Provide the diff, test output, and relevant product context before asking for review.
Ask for severity-ranked findings so blockers are easy to separate from suggestions.
Run any helper scripts in a controlled project directory with explicit output paths.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for broad approval without sharing the changed files or review scope.
Do not treat the basic helper scripts as a full static analysis engine.
Do not write report output to sensitive or shared system paths.

faq.question: Does this skill review real pull requests?
faq.answer: It can guide a pull request review when you provide the diff, files, or repository context.

faq.question: Does it run advanced static analysis?
faq.answer: No. The included scripts are basic scaffolds and do not perform deep language analysis.

faq.question: Can it help with security reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. The references include security review topics such as input validation, authorization, and data protection.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it create a review report?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper scripts can print a basic report and optionally write JSON output.

faq.question: What should users check before running scripts?
faq.answer: Users should confirm the target path and choose a safe output location before execution.
